title: Idle action on a bridge configuration
statement: For any compiled program, bridge input, optional control states $q,q'$, valid input-head position, assignment of stacks to the four stack names, and output word, applying the idle action with successor state $q'$ to the bridge configuration with state $q$ gives the bridge configuration with state $q'$ and the same input-head position, stack assignment, and output.
hypotheses_covered: An assignment $st$ of stacks to the four stack names
replaced:
Applying the idle action with a successor state $q'$ to a bridge configuration
changes only the control state to $q'$, leaving the input head, all stacks, and the
output unchanged.
